title: Our global conversation on the future of investment
summary: Over three days in Hong Kong, 5,000 delegates joined us at our Global Investment Summit to hear insights, exchange ideas, and get business done.
body_markdown:
Super-connector summit


(duration 3:13)


Hear from delegates at GIS 2026


### HSBC Global Investment Summit (GIS) 2026 wrap-up


**Duration:** 3:13


**Speakers:**


- [Brendan Nelson, Group Chairman, HSBC](https://www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-people/board-of-directors/brendan-nelson)
- [Georges Elhedery, Group CEO, HSBC](https://www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-people/board-of-directors/georges-elhedery)
- [Michael Roberts, CEO, HSBC Bank plc and CEO, Corporate and Institutional Banking](https://www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-people/senior-management/michael-roberts)

[LinkedIn (opens in new window) (opens in new window)](https://uk.linkedin.com/in/rachel-lord-545a1435)
- Kate Ferry, Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, Burberry Group
[LinkedIn (opens in new window)](https://uk.linkedin.com/in/kate-ferry-98650813)
- [Barry O’Byrne, CEO, International Wealth and Premier Banking, HSBC (opens in new window)](https://www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-people/senior-management/barry-o-byrne)
[LinkedIn (opens in new window)](https://hk.linkedin.com/in/barry-obyrne)
- [Pam Kaur, Group Chief Financial Officer, HSBC (opens in new window)](https://www.hsbc.com/who-we-are/our-people/board-of-directors/pam-kaur)
[LinkedIn (opens in new window) (opens in new window)](https://uk.linkedin.com/in/mpamkaur)


**\[Text on screen\]**
Brendan Nelson, Group Chairman, HSBC


**\[Brendan\]**


It is actually, for me, a great pleasure to welcome you to HSBC’s third Global Investment Summit.


**\[Text on screen\]**
Georges Elhedery, Group CEO, HSBC


**\[Georges\]**


The Global Investment Summit is a global conversation taking place right here in Hong Kong.


We are bringing together clients to share insights and ideas to understand what’s happening now, and inform what decisions they make next.


**\[Michael\]**


We’ve attracted 5,000 clients from around the world.


80% are C-suite type of individuals.


Markets don’t move without politics.


**\[Text on screen\]**
Michael Roberts, CEO, HSBC Bank plc and CEO, Corporate and Institutional Banking


Technology doesn’t scale without capital.


All these things come together; they intersect at GIS.


**\[David\]**


Hong Kong is really the capital of international connectivity.


**\[Text on screen\]**
David Liao, Co-CEO, Asia and Middle East, HSBC


So, it’s a very natural place for HSBC to host a GIS here, connecting the international investors, regional corporates, as well as great thought leaders and speakers to share the best ideas.


**\[Patrick\]**


Upstairs, there’s also business happening.


**\[Text on screen\]**
Patrick George, Global Head of Markets and Securities Services, HSBC


There is in excess of 240 companies from around the world, meeting our key institutional clients.


There are going to be more than 6,700 one-on-one meetings.


Our clients are trying to navigate a very complicated and complex world.


This is why we are here.


**\[Janet\]**


**\[Text on screen\]**
Dr Janet Yellen, Secretary, US Department of the Treasury (2021-5), Chair, Board of Governors, US Federal Reserve (2014-8)


HSBC has convened an incredibly knowledgeable group of investors who understand the global economy very well.


This is such a difficult time with so much uncertainty, sharing insights is very valuable.


**\[Rachel\]**


Talking to people today, I think the main benefit is exactly that.


**\[Text on screen\]**
Rachel Lord, Head of International, BlackRock


We’ve been meeting people in the corridors as we walk between the different audiences.


It’s the conversations that happen around the edges as well as the content.


**\[Kate\]**


**\[Text on screen\]**
Kate Ferry, Chief Financial Officer and Executive Director, Burberry Group


So alongside sharing perspectives with others in the luxury industry and indeed from the broad array of sectors.


Of course, it’s also a really efficient way of connecting companies with capital.


I’ve had a number of really excellent investor meetings with investors from the region and with investors globally.


**\[Barry\]**


**\[Text on screen\]**
Barry O’Byrne, CEO, International Wealth and Premier Banking, HSBC


The HSBC Global Investment Summit is where real decisions get shaped.


We think about the bringing together of those that set agendas, allocate capital and build businesses all in one place.


It creates a really unique opportunity for our wealth clients and for our partners.


**\[Pam\]**


GIS represents who we are.


**\[Text on screen\]**
Pam Kaur, Group Chief Financial Officer, HSBC


Connecting our customers, investors and colleagues here in Hong Kong, the spiritual home of HSBC.


**\[Text on screen\]**


HSBC | Opening up a world of opportunity
